title: Pikmin 4 Switch 2 Edition with Dandori Academy arrives November 12
dek: Nintendo's upgraded Pikmin 4 adds sharper visuals, voice commands for Oatchi and a 72-stage challenge mode released over time.

body.p: Pikmin 4 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy launches on Thursday, November 12, 2026, according to Nintendo's store listing. It is a Nintendo Switch 2 game.

Dandori Academy is a series of Dandori exam stages that test how efficiently you plan and command your Pikmin, with in-game medals as rewards. Nintendo says there will be 72 stages in total, released over time and varying in difficulty.
Nintendo lists higher-resolution visuals in both TV and handheld modes, plus voice commands to Oatchi, the rescue pup, using the Switch 2 system microphone.

body.h: Do I have to buy the game again?

body.p: Nintendo sells both the full Switch 2 Edition and a separate upgrade pack for players who already own the original Switch version. Check which one matches your copy before buying, since retailers list both.

body.h: Can I play with someone else?

body.p: Yes. The listing shows one to two players on a single system, plus two-player local wireless and online play. The game is rated for comic mischief and fantasy violence.
